name: Harald
aliases: King of the elves of Skemfar
description: Harald is the elf king of Skemfar on Kaldheim, Tyvar Kell's older brother, who united the wood elves and shadow elves.

description_citations.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

summary.text: Harald is the elf king of Skemfar on Kaldheim, Tyvar Kell's older brother, who united the wood elves and shadow elves.

citations.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

bio.text: After a Jaspera-fruit vision, Harald united the warring clans of Skemfar and proclaimed himself king of the elves.

citations.text: "Harald", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Elf", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Skemfar", section "Know locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Tibalt, disguised as Valki, subverted him with lies that the gods planned terrible things, and with the Omenpaths open during the Doomskar Harald marched to invade the other realms.

citations.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.
"Harald", section "Tibalt's machinations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Tyvar intercepted him in Bretagard and explained Tibalt's machinations, and Harald said Tyvar had prevented him from making a mistake.

citations.text: "Harald", section "Tibalt's machinations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

bio.text: He then fought the invaders, carried Kaya to the bridge to deliver the Sword of the Realms to Halvar, and trapped Varragoth with summoned snakes, though the demon broke free and was finally killed by Kaya.

citations.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.
"Harald", section "Tibalt's machinations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: He agreed with the human clans of Bretagard that elves and humans would live in peace until the elves could return to Skemfar.

citations.text: "Harald", section "Tibalt's machinations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

bio.text: In the New Phyrexian Invasion he rallied the elves onto the longships of all of Kaldheim's peoples, and he and Tyvar led the defense of the ten realms.

citations.work: March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking
citations.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

"Kaldheim (plane)", section "Phyrexia invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: As of the latest story Harald is alive on Kaldheim, counting the minutes until his brother Tyvar returns.

citations.work: March of the Machine | Episode 10: The Rhythms of Life
citations.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 10: The Rhythms of Life" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Harald unites the warring clans of Skemfar and names himself king.
timeline.quote: Harald united the warring clans and named himself king

citation.text: "Elf", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tyvar says Tibalt visited his brother Harald and the elves are now preparing to march against the gods.
timeline.quote: ever since that visit the elves have been preparing for war

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt, as Valki, convinces King Harald of Skemfar that the gods plan terrible things and that the elves must strike first.
timeline.quote: The only choice, if the elves were to survive, was clear: strike first.

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: The elves of Skemfar march into view, and Tyvar leaves to stop his brother's army.
timeline.quote: the elves of Skemfar, marching to war

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Harald's elves arrive and form a pike wall against the demons.
timeline.quote: A line of pike-bearers set their hafts against the ground, forming a wall between Kaya and the demons.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar introduces Kaya to his brother, King Harald.
timeline.quote: Harald, King of the elves of Skemfar, uniter of the tribes of Wood and Shadow.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Harald says Tyvar prevented him from making a mistake.
timeline.quote: He prevented me from making a mistake, here.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Harald carries Kaya on his reindeer through the battle to the bridge.
timeline.quote: He pulled her onto the reindeer.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya tosses the Sword of the Realms to Halvar, who says he can use it to separate the realms if given time.
timeline.quote: Kaya tossed him the sword, which turned end over end through the air

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Halvar asks them to hold the bridge while he sits and channels the sword.
timeline.quote: Hold the bridge until I can separate the realms once more.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: A new rift opens in the sky and Koma, the Cosmos Serpent, emerges.
timeline.quote: Koma. The Cosmos Serpent.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Varragoth, wounded with Tyvar clinging to his back, is bound by Harald's snakes and tears free.
timeline.quote: They wrapped round Varragoth's legs, binding him

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: At the crossroads, the leaders review losses and the draugr and demons that escaped.
timeline.quote: We broke the draugr lines and drove off their main body

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Harald announces the elves will return to Skemfar.
timeline.quote: The elves will return to Skemfar, to care for our own

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar goes to intercept his brother Harald; Cosima washes away an undead troll threatening Kaya.
timeline.quote: until Cosima , God of the Voyage, arrived and washed away the undead with a summoned wave.

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Varragoth intercepts Kaya and Cosima; Tyvar and the elven army united under Harald rescue them and let Kaya and Harald reach Halvar.
timeline.quote: the timely arrival of Tyvar and the elven army, now united under Harald

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Valkyries and Niko Aris pour out of the rift; Kaya phases through Varragoth's arm and cuts his throat with an axe, killing him.
timeline.quote: She phased through the demon's arm and swung an axe clean through his throat.

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tibalt, disguised as Valki, advises King Harald to prepare for war; Tyvar grows suspicious and investigates.
timeline.quote: Suspicious of this "Valki", Tyvar began to follow and investigate the god through the realms.

citation.text: "Tyvar Kell", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tyvar tells his brother Harald that the enemies are Phyrexians who will oil and transform the elves, and that Kaldheim cannot be saved by elves alone.
timeline.quote: This isn't an enemy the elves can vanquish alone.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Longships of all Kaldheim's peoples arrive and Harald rallies the elves to join them.
timeline.quote: The elves will lead it!

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Tyvar and Harald board a longship, and Harald addresses the united warriors with an oath of old grudges.
timeline.quote: Our grudges are ancient.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The fleet passes through the Cosmos and flies toward the Invasion Tree with valkyries.
timeline.quote: Valkyries fly alongside them toward the sharp barbs of the Invasion Tree

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: On Kaldheim, Harald counts the minutes until his brother Tyvar bursts from the sea clinging to a serpent's head.
timeline.quote: On the count of three hundred thirteen, Tyvar Kell bursts from the water clinging to the serpent's engorged head.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 10: The Rhythms of Life
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 10: The Rhythms of Life" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: During the invasion the ten realms collide and Harald and Tyvar Kell lead the defense.
timeline.quote: the ten realms collided, connecting Kaldheim as one plane

citation.text: "Kaldheim (plane)", section "Phyrexia invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tyvar and Harald lead the defense of Skemfar and Kaldheim; Tyvar slays a Phyrexian serpent and is desparked in the Great Desparkening.
timeline.quote: Tyvar was desparked in the Great Desparkening

citation.text: "Tyvar Kell", section "Invasion of the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya hands Halvar the Sword of the Realms and he closes the Omenpaths, ending the Doomskar.
timeline.quote: By focusing Halvar managed to close all the cracks and end Tibalt's Doomskar

citation.text: "Halvar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After a Jaspera-fruit vision, Harald unites the wood and shadow elves and proclaims himself king of the elves.
timeline.quote: Harald proclaimed himself king of the elves, ruler over all

citation.text: "Harald", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tibalt, disguised as Valki, subverts Harald with lies and prompts him to prepare for war; Tyvar grows suspicious and investigates.
timeline.quote: subverting him with his lies and prompting him to prepare his army for a war

citation.text: "Harald", section "Tibalt's machinations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With the Omenpaths open during the Doomskar, Harald marches to invade the other realms.
timeline.quote: Harald marched with his army to invade the other realms

citation.text: "Harald", section "Tibalt's machinations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Bretagard Tyvar explains Tibalt's machinations and Harald decides to fight the invaders and helps Kaya deliver the Sword to Halvar.
timeline.quote: Harald helped Kaya find Halvar and deliver the Sword.

citation.text: "Harald", section "Tibalt's machinations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Harald traps Varragoth with summoned snakes, but the demon breaks free and is finally killed by Kaya.
timeline.quote: The demon was only stopped by Kaya who killed him.

citation.text: "Harald", section "Tibalt's machinations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Harald and the human Clans of Bretagard agree elves and humans will live in peace until the elves can return to Skemfar.
timeline.quote: elves and humans must live in peace until the elves would be able to return to Skemfar

citation.text: "Harald", section "Tibalt's machinations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, Harald and Tyvar lead the defense of all ten realms of Kaldheim.
timeline.quote: Harald and his brother led the defense of all ten realms of Kaldheim

citation.text: "Harald", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Harald eats a Jaspera fruit, sleeps beneath its boughs, and claims a vision of a united elf dynasty.
timeline.quote: claims to have received a vision of a united elf dynasty

citation.text: "Skemfar", section "Know locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Halvar closes the cracks and ends the Doomskar, then disappears with the Sword.
timeline.quote: By focusing, Halvar managed to close all the cracks and end Tibalt's Doomskar.

citation.text: "Sword of the Realms", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: Not long ago he came to see my brother in court.
